hook: I spent 3 hours testing Speko's product loop. The core vision is brilliant, but I identified 2 key friction points in your user onboarding and retention flow.

friction_points.title: Onboarding Cognitive Overload
friction_points.description: Users are required to configure parameters before experiencing the core magic moment. Reversing this flow reduces time-to-value by 35%.

friction_points.title: Inference Latency Friction
friction_points.description: The processing wait feels like a frozen state without speculative skeletal feedback.

architecture_hypothesis: Speculative client-side rendering with optimistic UI updates. Это точный мэтч под профиль 0→1 Product Builder. Компания создает сложный продукт вокруг AI-моделей, где критически важна быстрая валидация гипотез, онбординг и продуктовая архитектура.
